name: dga-kit
description: Unofficial Saudi DGA Platforms Code guidance for Arabic-first frontend work. 11 skills covering foundations, 50 component specs, 19 templates and 1,052 tokens, on any UI library. Not affiliated with or endorsed by the Digital Government Authority.

interface.shortDescription: Unofficial DGA guidance for Arabic-first frontend work.
interface.longDescription: An unofficial helper for teams building Saudi government platforms: DGA Platforms Code guidance, Arabic-first RTL, accessibility, tokens, and launch-readiness checks. Works with any UI library — Tailwind, MUI, Chakra, shadcn/Radix, Ant Design, plain CSS, or DGA's own React package. Every rule names the DGA page set it came from and the date it was retrieved; where DGA is silent, the kit says so and names its fallback rather than inventing a rule. It is not DGA-endorsed, is not a compliance certification, and cannot make a platform compliant — verify anything that matters with DGA at DS-DGA@dga.gov.sa.
